decisions.reason: The spring-controlled flap weir sits close to the firm's core hydraulic steelwork business, so the engineering already invested in it argues for keeping it, and in a long municipal sales cycle one year of modest visibility can still be put down to temporary causes.

The energy management system is central to the firm's announced direction of digitally networked, energy-efficient water infrastructure, so management is strongly committed to it and will keep it despite any early disappointment.

The overflow flap gate is a multi-model product line with its own web page, which signals substantial investment and public commitment, and it sits close to the core business, making a drop very unlikely.
